after.problem:

after.worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3a+2x & =b \\ 2x & =b-3a \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}(b-3a) \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}([\begin{aligned}24 \\ 8 \\ -15 \\ -2\end{aligned}]-3[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}12 \\ 14 \\ -12 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 7 \\ -6 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}

Therefore, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=6+7=13.$

after.name: Question 2
after.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
after.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ {x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{3} \\ -2{x}_{3} \\ 0\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=8 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-6 \\ 2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=2\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -14\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, the system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=8 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-6 \\ {x}_{3}=5.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=5.$ Substituting this value in the second and first equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}_{2}-2(5)=-6\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=4 \\  & {x}_{1}+5=8\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=3.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=3$, ${x}_{2}=4$, and ${x}_{3}=5,$ which means 

$$
3{a}_{1}+4{a}_{2}+5{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=3+4+5=12.
$$

$$

$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=8 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-6 \\ 2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=2\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -14\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, the system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{3}=8 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-6 \\ {x}_{3}=5.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=5.$ Substituting this value in the second and first equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}_{2}-2(5)=-6\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=4 \\  & {x}_{1}+5=8\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=3.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=3$, ${x}_{2}=4$, and ${x}_{3}=5,$ which means 

$$
3{a}_{1}+4{a}_{2}+5{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=3+4+5=12.
$$

after.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}].

after.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ -4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-3 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=1 \\ 3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $2$ and adding the resulting equations, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & =-5,\end{aligned}
$$

which we substitute into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=1 \\ -2{x}_{1}-3(-5) & =1 \\ -2{x}_{1} & =-14 \\ {x}_{1} & =7.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=7$ and ${x}_{2}=-5$ into the third equation and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-4 \\ 3(7)+5(-5) & =-4 \\ -4 & =-4,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=7$ and ${x}_{2}=-5,$ which means

$$
7{a}_{1}-5{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=7+(-5)=2.
$$
